Question 4
?

Consider the finite region bounded by the curve y=2x2−x3 and the x-axis, shown above. What integral gives the volume of the solid generated when this region is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
2π∫02(2x2−x4)dx
b
2π∫02(−2x3+x4)2dx
c
2π∫02(2x3−x4)dx
d
2π∫02(x3−2x4)dx
e
π∫02(2x3−x4)dx
